evals.prompt: I am studying fiscal decentralization and need to construct a dataset on subnational borrowing autonomy. I want data for 30 countries over 20 years (2004-2023). The key variable is whether subnational governments can borrow independently from the central government. Can you help me set up a DRIL workflow to collect this data systematically from primary sources?
evals.expected_output: The skill should guide the user through creating a research instrument (codebook) for subnational borrowing autonomy, define the mapped unit space (30 countries x 20 years), establish an evidence policy with source hierarchy and citation contract, and explain the implementation and verification stages.
expectations: The output includes a draft research instrument (codebook) with at least one variable defined
The output defines a mapped unit space (countries x years)
The output specifies an evidence policy with source hierarchy
The output mentions the three DRIL stages (design, implementation, verification)
The output mentions data quality mechanisms (explicit gaps, structured uncertainty, append-only ledger)
